idea-plugin.name: Parquet Viewer - Query, Inspect & More
idea-plugin.description:
Parquet Viewer - Query, Inspect & More.

A lightweight, high-performance IntelliJ IDEA plugin to query .parquet files with SQL-like filters, inspect schema and statistics, and more — generate code, export data, and enjoy the geeky vibes.

🚀 Extreme Performance:
  • Instant Open: Reads metadata in O(1) time. Opens GB-sized files instantly.
  • Smart IO: Implements Row Group Skipping and Column Projection to minimize memory usage.
✨ Geeky Features:
  • Native Sorting: Correctly sorts numeric columns (Int, Long, Double) by value, not by string.
  • X-Ray Schema: View compression ratio, null percentage, and data size directly in the schema tree.
  • Hex View: Right-click any cell to inspect raw binary data and debug encoding issues.
  • Code Gen: Generate Hive DDL and Java POJO from schema with one click.
🎨 Modern UI & Easter Eggs:
  • Data Grid: Excel-style row headers, zebra striping, and explicit <null> rendering.
  • Geek Mode: Try typing rgb or phil in the filter box for a surprise! 🌈

idea-plugin.change-notes:
2.5.2 - Quality of Life Update

  • 🔍 Filter History: Your last 20 filter expressions are saved and available from the dropdown (▾) next to the filter bar. Persists across IDE restarts. (Thanks for the suggestion, heavy users!)
  • 💬 Filter Error Feedback: Invalid filter expressions now show a clear error message instead of failing silently. No more guessing why your data disappeared.
  • 📏 Column Width Persistence: Manually resized column widths now survive page changes, column toggles, and filter refreshes.
  • 🔧 Special Character Column Names: Columns with hyphens, dots, or Unicode characters now work correctly in LIKE and IN filter expressions.
  • 🏗️ Recursive Code Generation: Hive DDL and Java POJO generation now fully expand nested STRUCT types instead of showing "STRUCT<...>".
  • 🐛 Bug Fixes: Fixed MVEL expression compilation issue in IDE classloader environment. Various stability improvements.
